ingredientSections.heading: Peanut Ganache
items: 1 Cup (250g) smooth or crunchy peanut butter

methodSections.heading: Shortie Base
steps: Preheat the oven to 175°C (350°F) and grease a 23x33cm (9x13in) baking pan.
Whisk together the flour, baking soda, salt and brown sugar.
Add the melted butter and mix to combine until a dough forms.
Press firmly and evenly into the base of the prepared baking pan and bake for approximately 20 minutes or until lightly golden and slightly firm to the touch.

methodSections.heading: Peanut Ganache
steps: Place the white chocolate and cream into a microwave-proof bowl.
Microwave and stir in 1 minute intervals until it is completely melted and smooth.
Measure the peanut butter, salt and peanuts into a large bowl.
Mix in the melted white chocolate ganache into the bowl and thoroughly combine all the ingredients.
When the base is completely cool, pour the peanut butter white chocolate ganache over the top and spread out evenly with a spatula.
Chill in the fridge until firm.
To serve, slice into triangles and dip the longer side in melted dark chocolate and then in chopped peanuts.
